Every dog that arrives at Villalobos Rescue Center has a different story, and helping them means taking on a new set of challenges every day. Led by Tia Torres, the team works tirelessly to care for dogs that need attention, patience and a fresh start. Because behind every dog rescue is a commitment that goes far beyond bringing an animal to safety.
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees Season 8 Episodes 11, 2, 8 & 3 and Season 7 Episodes 19, 14, 16 & 12 on Animal Planet India!
